PKP Powązki — change here for suburban trains and the central station. We are in Żoliborz, the smallest of Warsaw’s districts, laid out in the 1920s as a garden city and still recognisably one. An hour ago we boarded outside a royal palace. Same ticket, same city — except that in between, it had to be destroyed once and built all over again.
